title: Reprogramming the Rossmann fold signature motif creates orthogonal redox biocatalysts.
authors: Ping, Yu; Kim, Jin Young; Dinh, Minh-Anh L; Luu, Emma; Worakaensai, Suphanida; Zhang, Shiding; Black, William B; Monge, Emma; Ng, Hans Jefferson C; Perea, Sean; Zhang, Yulai; Cui, Youtian; King, Edward; Siegel, Justin B; Li, Han
one_liner_zh: 该文通过Rosetta建模和结构比对重编程Rossmann折叠的GxGxxG基序，设计NMN(H)特异性氧化还原酶，虽以酶工程为主，但涉及蛋白质结构计算建模，可迁移至蛋白结构设计领域。
abstract: Biological reducing power is carried by nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (phosphate) (NAD(P)/H), which supports cellular functions and cannot be specifically directed to engineered metabolic pathways. Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN(H)) has emerged as an orthogonal redox cofactor to address this. Herein, to create NMN(H)-specific enzymes that no longer interact with cellular NAD(P)/H pools, we perturb the ancient, conserved GxGxxG motif in Rossmann fold enzymes that enables persistent NAD(P)/H recognition. We build variants NRC-01 and NRC-02 on phosphite dehydrogenase (PTDH), which eliminate electron leaking to NAD(P)H-dependent side reactions while driving NMNH-dependent biotransformation with ~240-fold higher productivity than existing catalysts. Testing the design principle on 12 other vastly diverse enzymes yields additional NMN(H)-orthogonal enzymes catalyzing valuable biomanufacturing reactions, and reveals a potential rule predicting the translatability of this method. Rosetta modeling, structural alignment, and experimental results reveal that Rossmann fold reprogramming, paired with engineered structural reinforcement, may offer a general route to orthogonal redox biocatalysts.
abstract_zh: 生物还原力由烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（磷酸）(NAD(P)/H) 携带，支持细胞功能，但无法特异性地导向工程化代谢途径。烟酰胺单核苷酸 (NMN(H)) 已作为一种正交氧化还原辅因子出现，以解决这一问题。在此，为了创建不再与细胞NAD(P)/H库相互作用的NMN(H)特异性酶，我们扰动Rossmann折叠酶中古老且保守的GxGxxG基序，该基序使NAD(P)/H得以持续识别。我们在亚磷酸脱氢酶 (PTDH) 上构建了变体NRC-01和NRC-02，这些变体消除了向NAD(P)H依赖性副反应的电子泄漏，同时驱动NMN(H)依赖性生物转化，其生产力比现有催化剂高约240倍。将该设计原理应用于其他12种高度多样的酶，产生了额外的NMN(H)正交酶，可催化有价值的生物制造反应，并揭示了一个可能预测该方法可转化性的规则。Rosetta建模、结构比对和实验结果表明，Rossmann折叠重编程，结合工程化结构强化，可能为获得正交氧化还原生物催化剂提供一条通用途径。
